Meta.title: SwipeJobs — Hourly work in Ferizaj
Meta.description: The app that connects hourly and shift workers with local businesses in Ferizaj. Swipe, match, and get to work.

Home.title: Hourly work, matched in a swipe.
Home.subtitle: SwipeJobs connects hourly and shift workers with local businesses. Swipe on jobs you like, match with employers, and arrange the work — all in one app.
Home.audienceWorkersBody: Build a quick profile, swipe through shifts near you, and get discovered by employers — no CV required.
Home.audienceEmployersBody: Post a role in minutes and swipe through workers who are genuinely interested. Match, then chat directly.
Home.howStep1Body: Workers swipe right on jobs they want.
Home.howStep2Body: When the employer swipes back, it's a match.
Home.howStep3Body: Contact details unlock and you arrange the job in chat.
Home.footerMilestone: Foundation build (M0) — design system, languages, and app shell.

Styleguide.title: Design system
Styleguide.subtitle: The reusable components and tokens that power SwipeJobs.
Styleguide.colorsBody: Semantic tokens that re-theme automatically in dark mode.
Styleguide.buttonsBody: Every intent, size, and state — including loading.
Styleguide.inputsBody: Labels, help text, and error states.
Styleguide.skeletonsBody: Designed loading, empty, and error states — never a blank screen.
Styleguide.overlaysBody: A draggable sheet for mobile-first actions.
Styleguide.sheetBody: Drag the handle down or tap outside to close. Built with Framer Motion.
Styleguide.inputErrorMsg: Password must be at least 8 characters.
Styleguide.swipeBody: The premium card workers swipe. Drag physics + the match moment arrive in M5.
Styleguide.listingCardBody: The premium listing card workers swipe — built from real listing data in M3.
Styleguide.liveSwipeBody: Drag the card (or use the physics) and preview the match moment — the real M5 swipe engine.
